portfolio:brief.q: In one sentence only: name the single position you are most worried about.
portfolio:brief.a: Hold ETN — do nothing, but it's the one I'm watching closest today.
points: ETN is down 6.3% today near $361.88 on heavy selling volume, the sharpest drop in the book.
Earnings land Friday — that report will confirm whether this is noise or a real problem.
No sell signal yet; the business thesis hasn't broken, so this stays a hold not a cut.

portfolio:brief.q: Which position did you just tell me you were watching closest? One sentence.
points: Still the one I'm watching closest today.
Earnings due in 2 days; wait for the report before deciding anything.

portfolio:brief.q: I’m not interested in brk b
portfolio:brief.a: Fine — Berkshire is off the list. Trim $190 PANW at market near $332, then buy $150 GD near $384.
points: I'm changing my top idea from BRK-B to GD because you don't want Berkshire, not because Berkshire broke.
GD reported record backlog of $136.5 billion on July 29, up 32%, and raised full-year profit guidance.
The PANW trim funds it — PANW duplicates CRWD, which you own bigger and is performing better.
Second choice if you want a cheaper entry: buy $75 JNJ near $266, which raised guidance July 15.

portfolio:brief.a: Hold NET through the August 6 report — then trim $180 near $278 only if it's higher after the print.
points: The trim is conditional, not an order for today: nothing happens unless NET rises after Thursday's earnings.
It's a partial trim of a $514 position, leaving about $334 invested — I'm raising cash, not exiting the name.
Reason: you have $0 dry powder, and NET is my lowest-conviction holding, so it funds the General Dynamics buy.
Guggenheim reiterated Sell with a $140 target on 2026-08-04, but Truist, TD Cowen and Citizens all raised targets to $300-$330 — I side with the bulls on the business, I just need the cash.

portfolio:brief.q: We fuckin nailed the VRT buy. It popped almost immediately after we bought
portfolio:brief.a: Hold VRT — do nothing, let the winner run.
points: You bought near $243 last week and it's $255.62 now, up 5.82% today — that timing was right.
Q2 sales grew 24% and full-year guidance was raised on July 29, the real reason it's ripping, not luck.
24 of 24 analysts rate it a buy with price targets averaging near $339 — well above here.
No new buy or trim needed; VRT is already 14% of your book and doing its job.

portfolio:brief.q: I was just saying good job. We aced the move this morning
portfolio:brief.a: Hold VRT — do nothing, just enjoy the win.
points: Thanks — the $243 entry into a name with raised guidance is exactly the setup we look for.
VRT is $255.62 now, up 5.82% today, and still rated a buy by every analyst covering it.
Same plan stands: let it run, no new order needed here.

portfolio:brief.q: Tell me about Sofi. Their ceo is buying
portfolio:brief.a: Watch SoFi, don't buy now — it's already run past the CEO's buying levels.
points: CEO Anthony Noto bought $2.25 million of stock between March and June, all under $18 — it's now $27.78.
SoFi beat and raised guidance on July 29 after record member growth, so the business is real.
Goldman's $21 target and Mizuho's $22 target are both below today's price, so Wall Street sees it as fully valued here.
You have no cash to deploy anyway — watch for a pullback toward $22-23 before considering a small starter position.

portfolio:brief.q: Citi changed its target price for anet to 215… it’s pretty much already there. We have turned 150 into 190 on a small bet. Is this a spot to trim, or just let it keep going?
portfolio:brief.a: Hold ANET — do nothing. Let it run.
points: Arista beat and raised full-year revenue to about $12.6 billion on August 4 — targets are chasing the business, not capping it.
TD Cowen went to $210 on August 5 and most of the street sits at $200; those numbers move up again next quarter.
It is only 2% of your book at $190 — trimming your best idea when it is your smallest position is backwards.
You are up 27% in under a year, so selling now hands a chunk to short-term taxes; revisit above $250.
